payload.title: Reject E011 regime specialists
payload.decision: Reject H015/E012 and retain E011 unchanged as deployment primary. Two worth screens completed 226 branches with zero positive pooled gains. The formal nested confirmation completed nine representative branches; the best KNN residual expert gained only 0.013698 RMSE, won 15/25 cells, and regressed spatial groups 0/1 plus typewell group 0. E006 remains secondary fallback and E004 exact fallback. No package or submission is authorized.
payload.rationale: The strongest branch passed map direction and special-slice checks but failed the frozen minimum gain, outer-cell, spatial, and typewell gates. All controls and independent reproduction passed, so the rejection reflects model evidence rather than execution failure.
payload.revisit_trigger: Reopen specialization only after a new legal mechanism demonstrates stable cross-fitted routing evidence not derivable from another partition or local smoother over the same E011 feature space.
